New Roofs in Stafford and Staffordshire

We strip and replace pitched roofs across Stafford, Lichfield, Tamworth, Cannock and Stoke-on-Trent. A typical new roof takes us around 4 to 5 days, and in an emergency we can have a roof stripped, felted and battened with new tiles in 2 days.

Call 07478 904491 WhatsApp Us

Stripped, Felted, Battened and Tiled

Our photos follow a new roof through each stage. The old roof comes off down to the rafters, red breathable membrane is rolled out across the timbers, new battens are fixed over it, and then the new tiles or slates go on row by row from the eaves up to a new ridge.

Concrete Tiles and Slate

Most of the new roofs in our photos are finished in dark concrete interlocking tiles, and one is in red and brown tiles. Another job was re-slated, with the slates laid course by course over the new membrane and battens.

Scaffold Up Before the Roof Comes Off

On a full re-roof the scaffold goes up round the house first, on semis and detached houses alike, and the old tiles are stacked on it as the roof is stripped.

How Long It Takes

  • A typical new roof: around 4 to 5 days
  • An emergency re-roof: stripped, felted, battened and tiled with new tiles in 2 days

Signs It Needs Looking At

These are general signs, not a diagnosis. If you spot one, call or send us a photo and we'll tell you what we think.

  • Slipped, cracked or missing tiles in more than one place
  • Damp or daylight showing through the boards in the loft
  • Old felt that has torn or gone brittle at the eaves
  • Repairs that keep coming back on the same roof
  • A ridge or rafters that have started to sag

Useful to Tell Us About Your Roof

  • Whether the roof is tiled or slated now
  • Whether the house is a bungalow, a semi or detached
  • If there is a chimney, a dormer or roof windows on it
